adapter_evidence.rule: On .system-blade pages, lowercase/trim .sku-model rel, exclude empty or srs prefix, link /{lang}/products/system/datasheet/{sku}. Never infer SKU from filename.

known_gaps: Sitemap URLs are discovery candidates, not downloaded documents or a complete website inventory.

Coverage is limited to public Supermicro hosts, sitemap pages, document literals and the observed read-only Manuals form; the official learn-more.supermicro.com asset host is included, while unrelated external mirrors remain excluded. Undiscovered JavaScript APIs remain a review gap.
FAQ and image sitemaps are recorded as additional sources, not traversed by this baseline.
Product role labels above name sitemap sources, not a replacement for the vendor's first-level product categories.
User authorized execution on 2026-09-23; this records user authorization, not a vendor license. No public redistribution. Robots rules remain independently enforced.
HTML-only manuals are retained as discovery snapshots, not counted as PDF documents. Public completeness, PCN completeness and unavailable/deleted products are not inferred from queue exhaustion.
Vendor first-level labels are preserved; URL-based membership is explicitly inferred, and unresolved documents remain unassigned. Collections describe document purpose, not vendor taxonomy.
